The Law of One Who Read and Erred, And a Place Where There is No One Who Knows How to Read [Torah] Precisely. Containing 2 S'ifim: One who read and erred, even in the pronunciation of one single letter, we make [the reader] go back [and read again].Gloss: The same law applies to the chazzan [i.e. the one who reads for others] who reads. (Beit Yosef and Piskei Maharia, Siman 181).
